pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; standing firmly on hind legs, head held slightly forward and high.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The single nasal horn is the central vertical axis.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Slightly low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking up just enough to emphasize the head and neck.
pose_constraints.grounding: Hind feet planted on cracked, reddish-brown clay/silt; tail tucked directly behind the legs.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The robust torso and tail are completely occluded by the chest and thick neck. Silhouette width max 280px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The distinctive single nasal horn and brow ridges must be clearly visible and centered at the top of the head.

character_details.expression: Intense, focused gaze; powerful, slightly downturned mouth.
character_details.texture: Rough, pebbly scales with a mottled camouflage pattern of browns, ochres, and dark reds; subtle battle scars.
features: Single, blunt nasal horn atop the snout.
Prominent brow ridges over the eyes.
Short, robust skull with powerful jaws.

environmental_details.ground: Dry, cracked reddish-brown clay or silt, characteristic of Madagascar's semi-arid regions, with sparse, tough grasses.
flora: Scattered hardy cycads and low-lying ferns in the far background, blurred to maintain focus on the dinosaur.
environmental_details.sky: Bright, sun-drenched Late Cretaceous sky, slightly hazy with heat, casting strong, defined shadows.
environmental_details.lighting: Harsh, direct overhead sunlight creating strong contrasts, highlighting the rugged texture of the skin and horns.
